Ph.D. Application
More information about our Civil Engineering Program can be found at https://www.utep.edu/engineering/civil/academic-programs/doctoral-program.html.
Three research centers are affiliate with the Civil, Environmental and Construction Engineering Department. These centers include:
Center for Transportation Infrastructure Systems (CTIS),
Center for Environmental Research and Management (CERM),
Center for Inland Desalination (CIDS),
Please apply as soon as possible for full consideration. Please see the graduate school website for instructions on how to apply and the deadlines: http://graduate.utep.edu/index.html
You can apply through the following link: http://www.utep.edu/graduate/apply-now/apply-now.html
Information about tuition and fees can be found through the following link: https://www.utep.edu/extendeduniversity/utepconnect/tuition-and-fees/
The decision to admit you is based on a number of factors including your undergraduate background, your experience, your area of interest as reflected in your statement of purpose and your GRE and TOEFL (or IELTS, if applicable). In the statement of purpose please let us know which of the options (Geotechnical and Pavements, Transportation, Structures or Environmental Engineering) fits best with your interest.
When accepted into our program, the Department of Civil, Environmental and Construction Engineering usually provides support to most students for one year. The monthly stipend is about $1900 for entering PhD students. The renewal of your support after this initial year depends on your satisfactory progress. For more information about assistantship please refer to https://www.utep.edu/engineering/civil/academic-programs/doctoral-program-assistantship.html
Please forward all your questions about the application process or admission status to gradschool@utep.edu not to the Civil, Environmental and Construction Engineering Department.
